company_info.company_description: "Peak Energy Group is an up and coming locally founded business aiming to deliver value for money systems with aesthetics a key point of difference for our designs.Justin is the Director and also head installer of the business. Quality over quantity is what we pride ourselves on at Peak and in doing so all our work is carried out by in-house installers.Our site appointments with Thomas our energy consultant are free of charge, and both the customer and the business gain so much value from this process. This is so important when selecting a local business like Peak Energy Group to install solar on your property."

reviews.review_description: Happy with the installation and outcome. We have achieved the level of storage we need. Peak Energy were easy to deal with and installation was quick and efficient.

We had a solar battery installed by Peak Energy at the start of October. Getting the quote was an easy process as well as professional. The staff were also very friendly. We were more than happy with the price for the purchase and installation of the unit. The battery was installed quickly, professionally and once again the installers were very friendly.They were also very helpful when I had a couple of questions later.We highly recommend Peak Energy Solutions.

We got the Peak Energy Group  to install our battery. They were fantastic we could not fault them in any way.From the time they quoted for the job till completion.We are very happy with our batteries for our solar system.We would recommended to anyone that needs a solar system

Peak Energy installed a 20kW solar system together with a 40kW battery and DC charger for us.   They were very professional, efficient and responsive throughout the process, from Thomas quoting on the system, to Bridgette managing admin and Justin's team doing the install.   There was obvious pride in the quality of their product and workmanship which is not that common anymore.   I would highly recommend them.

The sale and quoting process was a breeze, the team at Peak provided several quotes and were more than happy to answer any questions we had.The installation process was quick and easy, the team were more than happy to provide feedback on best location for installation and explained what they were doing each step of the installation.All grid connections and documentation for or energy provider was organised and dealt with by Peak Energy.

Initially had a 4kw system through a new build. Decided to upgrade to a 6.6kw system late in the contract. This was easily done and the price was within budget.Install was a breeze and Peak Energy arranged the grid connection and the solar rebates.Customer service was on point and no fuss.Highly recommend Peak Energy Wodonga.

I found peak through solarquotes.com.au and I could not be happier. Thomas came to the house and explained everything about the systems they install, why they use the brands they use and answered all questions I put to him. Justin made the install seamless, communicating everything and offering changes that he recommended to cater specifically to our needs. Bridgette did all the admin side and communicated and responded very promptly and clearly. Overall, I can not recommend these guys enough. They all made the process so easy and were so polite and welcoming throughout the process 10/10
Purchase and installation went through without a problem. I would recommend them to anyone.

From the quoting process to the admin requirements to the installation all was excellent and professional. All additional questions were answered while in the 'waiting for installation phase'. An excellent post installation lesson was delivered. Customer service from the entire team was excellent with pre arrival messaging on both days of the install. Would not hesitate to recommend Peak Energy based on my experience.

Our experience with Peak Energy Group (Albury/Wodonga) has been nothing short of fantastic. Their response to our initial request was prompt and their system engineer came around to discuss our requirements and look at possible options. As there was already an old 3kW system on the roof we needed to have that removed as well. We were given a range of options including different brands to choose from with detailed information on system components, ROI, expected energy generation, clear breakdown of costs and so on.  Very easy to follow and very thorough. Follow-up calls to clarify any matters were responded to rapidly and to our satisfaction.On the installation date, the team arrived on time as scheduled, Fast and efficient, they removed the old system and had the new installation completed by 3.30pm. All the old panels and framing (other than some I said I'd keep for repurposing) were taken away, as was all the packaging from the new system.  Our garage, where the system was installed, was left just as it was found. As we already had grid connection via our old system, the new one was up and running immediately after installation.  We were shown how to use the Sigen app to monitor and customise our system to suit our purposes. Very happy, and the team were great.The customer service after the installation has been flawless and responsive.  We had an issue a few weeks after installation when our inverter lost its connection to the AusNet utility server, reducing our solar export from 5kW to 1kW per hour.  It took few days to resolve as the issue lay with AusnEt not with our installation. Now, it is working perfectly.We can highly recommend this company for the great service, efficient installation and the friendly and responsive team.

Could not be happier with the service from the guys and Bridget ,they answered any questions I had, the system was up and running within a day, no problems at all thank you very much guys you're all did a great job

Awesome company to deal with walked us through  everything start to finish guys were in and out in under a day no mess no fuss hooked up ready to go. Now to decide on how many batteries do we go with.
Quoting and customer service are really fantastic until the end of the connection of the grid. Wonderful job.

All my dealings with Peak Energy Group went smoothly. My inquiry was  responded to promptly and Thomas came to meet and discuss shortly after that. His suggestions all made great sense and were all worth taking into consideration. The proposed timeline was fairly well met, considering the inclement weather. The installation process was fast and smooth, with minimal interruption to power supply and I am very happy with the system

I have no hesitation in recommending Peak Energy. Every part of the process to install solar and batteries at my home was seamless.I also didn’t have to deal with anyone else in relation to my energy supplier and applying for the government concessions.  This was a big help.I felt I could trust the team and they were very punctual, good natured and very helpful in explaining the whole process. I feel confident that if I had any concerns in the future I could contact them and they would help me.  I was also pleasantly surprised that the final total cost was less than the quote…amazing!
The team supplied great customer service, product installation and ongoing service +++

Quote from all three was efficient and informative. PeakEnergy had best Quote but not a huge amount of difference. But they provided great education on Solar for us who knew not a lot before. Personal visit helped with this.Great help on the admin side to support the rebates and battery loan. Good communication all through.Install was amazing. Hard working efficient and very polite. Clean and tidy. Punctual. We elected not to pursue feed tariffs for the 1kW.Highly recommend this group.

Highly professional company.  they responded to my initial enquiry promptly then were back to me with a detailed quote in good time.I found them to be  highly motivated,with in- depth knowledge of the systems available and the ability to explain the process clearly. The installation was carried out in a professional manner that impressed me greatly. I would recommend this company to anyone.
Great process from start to finish. Quality installation and adaptable installer's

Justin and Tom were great, quoting process straightforward. Justin has a clear passion for the technology and is a font of information. Installation was quick, clean and professional, the team arrived on time and installed the system with minimal fuss. Everything just worked. Highly recommend.
Friendly, knowledgeable staff. Very neat install. Very reasonable prices. Good communication and support at all times.

Dear PEAK Energy Team,I wanted to extend my heartfelt thanks for the outstanding workmanship and excellent communication throughout the sales and installation of our new solar battery system. Your team's professionalism and dedication made the entire process smooth and stress-free.From the initial consultation to the final installation, every step was handled with great care and attention to detail. Your clear and timely communication kept us informed and confident in our decision to choose PEAK Energy.We are thrilled with our new solar battery system and look forward to enjoying the benefits of clean, renewable energy for years to come. Thank you once again for your exceptional service.Warm regards,

We spent months asking many questions of the Peak Energy team and they were fantastic in designing the solar system that was best for us.We feel we have done the right thing environmentally and the system will pay for itself in electricity bill savings in less than 4 years.It takes a bit to understand the system but Peak Energy took the time to ensure we were comfortable with how it all works.Highly recommended!

I have never left a review for anything, but for the service and professional attention I received from Thomas, Justin and the team, I just have to make an exception. I understand electronics and particularly DC systems. I approached a couple of other companies but was not impressed by their sales pitches, which was simply to sell me a solar system. When I drilled deeper into the technology I lost them, as they wanted to sell me their recommended system, not what I wanted. Peak Energy Group are a team of true professionals, willing to listen and to develop a solar solution that I wanted. They even convinced me to change the system I initially wanted, by showing me the technical benefits of what they proposed, versus what I had proposed. What sets them aside is their friendly “neighbourly” attitude, and a desire to go out of their way to ensure you achieve what you want, and at a fair price. I highly recommend PEAK ENERGY GROUP, and if you are serious about solar, make sure you give them a call. You will not be disappointed!
Thank you Justin and Marshy for installing our amazing solar!! We are so pleased with the professionalism, our service and the high quality product. Highly recommend Peak for any solar needs!

I have used Peak Energy previously for both a heat pump hot water system and solar panels so when i decided to install solar batteries i contacted them for a quote along with a couple of others.I received Justin's quote in the evening on the day i contacted him, when compared with the other quotes the batteries were a better brand and the price was considerably less.The installation was completed in the week leading up to xmas on the chosen day and as the previous installations, professional, neat, tidy and working.Justin has since contacted me re satisfaction of the system and any queries i have.I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Peak Energy to anyone who is looking to get a solar panels or batteries installed.

It's a pleasure to support Justin and the team at Peak Energy Group with this review.From the outset, with my initial contact with Thomas, to a follow up on site with Justin to the installation carried out by Justin and Jayden in one day, they have been professional and courteous. The installation is extremely neat and tidy with my Sigenergy hardware proudly on display in the garage with all wiring being hidden behind the wall.Pre installation paperwork and approvals were more than ably handled by Bridgette who made it all look simple!What a great team and I couldn't be happier seeing my Sigenergy battery providing all the power I need in the evenings. It is performing just as they said it would.Highly recommended!
Very good people all the way through the process from sales to install kept up to date with great communication.
Justin, Thomas and the team made the whole process from start to finish so easy and informative. The after care and follow up has also been fantastic!

They gave good detail about the systems they could provide, their quality and also gave me three different options to choose from.The installers were quick and efficient and did a neat job. They answered all our questions about the installation and clearly explained how the system and the application for monitoring works. The installers reaffirmed what they were going to do and checked that were happy with the positioning of the battery, inverter and panels. We could recommend them

Having not had solar before, they guided us through all the different options and the process was so smooth and seamless. The after sales care is great. They installed very quickly and were very respectful of our property and the service was the best.Would highly recommend these guys, they know their solar!!So happy we were put onto them from SolarQuotes.

We had a great experience with Thomas and Justin at Peak Solar and look forward to utilising our new solar system. The team was very friendly and informative, the install was simple, and the app is very easy to use. Highly recommend!
The sales and quote process was great, the guys were prompt answering all questions.the help with the paperwork made it so easy.Installation guys were quick and on time. Left site very clean.

I have used Peak Energy Group for 2 installations, one for installation of a Heat Pump hot water service and the other for installation of Solar Panels.  I would highly recommend them.  The whole process for both was smooth and stress free.  The guys were lovely to deal with and really helpful and their follow up service has been really appreciated.
Justin and his crew were very professional and freindly . Would recomend them to everyone.Thanks for the great workmanship

We recently shifted to the area and were fortunate enough to choose Peak Energy for our solar panels and battery. They were extremely prompt to our requests, easy to deal with and the installation was a breeze. To date the system exceeds our expectations and would highly recommend them..

Amazing customer service.Full of information to help support you make your own decision.Non pushy with consideration into the specific needs to be met.I recommend to anyone who wants geniune local service from a talented team who think into the future with organic improvements.

The initial meeting to discuss the purchase options and alternatives was very clearly explained. The Energy Consultant, Thomas Chettleburgh, was a very articulate and enthusiastic representative. His interpersonal skills were excellent and he made us feel comfortable throughout the discussion, which took place in our home.The actual installation was conducted by people within the local business community and was carried out efficiently. The follow-up provided by the Energy Consultant, Thomas, was regular as promised. He indicated that he would not discontinue contact until the system was fully operational.A job well done and would recommend this company to anyone living in their service area.

From the very beginning, the quoting process was efficient and reasonably priced.  Guidance on solar size and design was readily provided and I quickly developed confidence in their opinions.  Installation was on time, performed efficiently and I was well supported with any queries afterwards.  So far (since June 2024), I have been very impressed with the performance of the system and had no significant issues.  I would highly recommend Peak Energy for your solar system.

It was a pleasure to deal with Peak Energy Group. Very professional and easy to communicate with. Best price and great result. Very tidy installation. I would strongly recommend using Peak Energy Group.

Peak Energy replied very quickly to our initial inquiry. Very professional front man covering all the details and systems and sizing on offer.  Took an hour and was very informative.  Once the paperwork (including rebates) was complete the installation of the heat pump went in quickly and about a week later the installation was completed.  Each visit was punctual and the installers tidied up everything before they left.Customer service was very good leading up to the installation.  Have only just had the Electrical Inspector so the grid connection is yet to go ahead.Would definitely recommend this company to others.
Good price.  Good communication.System installed as quoted and working as promised.
Great team, quoting experience was excellent as they answered all my questions, installation was seamless and follow up customer service was top notch.

Peak Solar impressed us from start to finish. Thomas was brilliant and great to deal with. He explained each step in detail and was quick to answer any questions throughout the process. Justin and the team were so efficient and professional with the install. We are very pleased with the final result and looking forward to being (almost) power bill-free. Marque and Jenni.

Peak Energy Group were very professional and answered all questions thoroughly and candidly.  The quoting process was efficient and easy to understand. The installation was conducted effectively and timely.I would recommend this company to anyone.

Great company that not only provides excellent service but is very reasonably priced. The follow-up service is second to none and whilst I rarely write reviews this is a company I felt deserved the time. The best thing I can say is they listened and advised based on my needs, budget and long term goals to provide a system that is perfect for me now and into the future. Thanks guys you truly are why locals are best.
Couldn’t fault Peak Energy GroupProfessional from start to install

Of the 3 quotes, Peak Energy provided the best quote, as well as being very knowledgeable on the latest technology.  Installation went smoothly and they tidied up everything before leaving. I highly recommend Justin and his team at Peak Energy Group.
The staff at Peak Energy Group were exceptionally helpful, offering expert advice and guidance throughout the entire process. I highly recommend their services.
Great customer service, great work ethic, quick to get my system up, great follow up after the job was done and great price. Couldn't be happier with Peak Energy, highly recommended.
Reasonable price, Installation prompt and fast. Good qaulity. They gave lots of information on the job and answer any questions you had. Highly recommend
From the start to finish easy to deal with. Professional.  Would recommend.

Right from the start we were impressed with the way Thomas spent time with us explaining everything so well, and then the following communication with both Thomas and Justin (company manager) keeping us in the loop and sorting out the minor difficulties of us living in a strata village was excellent. On installation day they sent us a message fifteen minutes before they arrived to let us know that they were on their way, the team were polite and friendly, and the installation was completed within the morning. Justin connected everything for us, and informed our electricity provider, so it was all handled for us with a minimum of effort on our part. Our experience with Peak Energy Group was positive in every way and we would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone considering installing solar panels.

My installer provider an excellent sales pitch and backed it up with equally excellent installation. The process was surprisingly quick once I signed up. They fitted me in their busy schedule relatively soon and the job was done in half a day. Support and follow up calls afterwards were very useful. No issues since.

My experience with Peak Energy has been excellent.  They arrived when they said they would, took time to answer my questions, explain the process and offer additional commentary about their product.Installation was on time and completed within the day and follow up assistance has been provided readily and with enthusiasm.Highly recommend Peak Energy  to those who are considering installing solar panels.  Their pricing is competitive as well.

The whole process from beginning to end was handled in a professional manner. These guys know their stuff. We had some issues that they had to overcome and they did so through consultation with us  and some ingenuity on their part. Their follow up meant we did not have to worry about the grid connection or our energy provider. They were polite and took time to make sure we understood how the new system worked. I recommend them highly.

We cannot fault Peak Energy - their service was punctual, the quoting process was seamless and the guys were very accommodating.They showed up when they said they would, they explained the system clearly and they organised the grid connection in a timely manner.Their customer service was and still is fantastic! We highly recommend Peak Energy.

Our new solar panel experience from Peak Energy Solutions was a breeze from start to finish - the quote process was very thorough with all questions answered.  Installation was quick and efficient with all tradesmen kind and courteous.Customer service was exceptional with any concerns or questions answered promptly and effeciently.  I would recommend them highly.
Professional, good service easy to deal with. Value for money good components, polite tidy and punctual. Organised grid connection.

Thomas the sales person was friendly very helpful and showed you the different systems in easy to understand language.Installation was easy the installer was prompt efficient very tidy punctual and explained everything about the solar we purchased and if we ever want to install a battery how easy it was for them to install.Customer service again was top notch with all certification and to organise the grid connection the same day as installation.We can’t fault Peak Energy would recommend them to anyone looking to install solar
Outstanding customer service, know their product well, including installation, and made great recommendations. Highly recommend.

The lads do a great job from sales/design & quoting, to the forms and important docs. Right down to the install would recommend anyone looking for solar.Justin and the crew are all locals who all grew up here. Making solar a breeze with no worries.

Gentleman Thomas comes to view home, give advice and gather all the required details. A quote with options follows.Didn't have to wait long, once we gave the ok. Justin and the guys arrived as arranged and they didn't take too long to install, tidy up, explain how it works, etc.Installed 15 large panels with most of them out of view to front street at our request.Great customer service with follow-up emails, plus all got sorted with our power provider as well.Very happy clients of Peak Energy Group thanks to Finn at Solar Quotes.

Contact made by Peak Energy Group from my enquiry on solarquotes website was prompt, site visit arranged and quote provided by Thomas done efficiently and thoroughly. All my queries were answered by Thomas or Justin in a timely and respectful manner.The installation was clean and tidy, everything as I expected it to be. They were on time in the morning and by the afternoon our new battery was grid connected and charging. We haven’t imported from the grid since!Installation has been inspected and approved.Overall an excellent customer experience. Very happy to recommend Peak Energy Group.

Justin and Co made everything very easy for my husband and I. Their communication was amazing, we were absolutely never left waiting around. Our quotes were well explained in person, and delivered almost instantly after our initial visit. Justin and Co. were super polite, very friendly and absolutely nothing was a bother for them. Installation was quick and the result is more than we could have hoped for. Our system works brilliantly, was up and running right after installation and looks amazing on our house. After being let down by other tradesmen and companies, Justin and Co. went above and beyond and restored our faith in humanity a little - absolutely recommended!!!

We were very fortunate to have Peak Energy Group install our solar.  They were very professional in all aspects of the process. The team worked quickly and efficiently, and left the place very tidy.  I would recommend Peak Energy Group to anyone considering installing solar. Thanks you Justin, Thomas and team.

Peak Energy Group were the first company to respond to my request for a quote, the first to attend and the only company to follow the quote up. Tom visited the house and gave me (who had no real idea about solar) a great presentation and explained the entire process. Installation was spot on when I was told, multiple staff arrived and the entire system was installed in a matter of hours. I went out after they left to clean up and other than the newly installed system, there was not a wire, screw or piece of cardboard to be found - the place was exactly how they had found it. Connection to the grid is in progress now and I had a minor issue with the inverter app, called to ask about it, call was answered straight away and my issue was solved in about 1 minute. All communication to them is promptly responded to and every timeframe they gave me was met. I cannot recommend this company highly enough. If you need a solar installer - look no further and give the guys a ring you won’t be disappointed.

Everything went like clockwork. Cannot fault their service, the System works beautifully and the Backup appears to work in a milli second. Couldn't be happier at this early stage. Pumping out the power to house, battery and Grid.

The service from Justin at Peak Solar was brilliant from the beginning.Justin contacted me promptly and came to inspect and quote at a convenient time. He was polite and honest throughout the whole process. Justin was very quick to reply to my queries after receiving the quote.The installation process was quick, efficient, tidy and did not inconvenience me in any way. All visible work is extremely neat and tidy.Justin arranged all the paperwork, grid connection and rebate applications so I had very minimal paperwork to complete for the process.The customer service and support was exceptional from beginning to end.

Disappointed I did not get the current Jinko panel's I signed up for 440w only discovered it when they had installed them on my roof.They explained that 440 not available at present so installed 430w without constalation.I also requested the 8kw FroniusInverter told no availability in Aust at present.No discount offered on the panel's.

The sales/quoting process was very good. The Company answered all our questions and explained the installation process in simple, easy to understand terms..The installer arrived on time, was very pleasant, unobtrusive, tidy and polite.Customer service was great. Any problems were quickly addressed and fixed.

The sales and quoting process with Thomas was second to none, he was fantastic and left us with all questions answered which gave us peace of mind.Justin and the team were super efficient when doing the install. They were a pleasure to have at my house for the install. Could not speak highly enough of the process.Peak Energy Group have been amazing with us from the moment Thomas contacted us for the sale, right through the whole process and even still have communication from the team well after the install and meter alteration has been completed. Truly showing their care and passion to the job and us the customer.

The whole process was super easy and Justin was very transparent with what we will get and where the costs come from. Very competitive price with quality components and quality installation. They were happy to spend the time discussing (and providing sketches) of where the panels will sit so we knew how the system would end up looking once installed.So far system seems to be performing very well, even on cloudy days.

Justin took care of the whole process seamlessly and professionally even with a complicated roof on my home. He worked out a system to make sure that I got the maximum from my solar investment and I couldn’t be happier!

If i could give Justin from Peak Solar Solutions more stars I would.  If you want someone who cares about their work and is well priced and uses quality components Justin is your man.After getting in contact with solarquotes for 3 quotes from local installers, Justin at Peak Solar Solutions sent me a quote with 3 different options within 3 days.  He ended up being the only company to send a quote.  After talking to him on the phone and looking at the different systems he came out to check out the site and we quickly realised that the power situation was more complicated than we had thought (in a good way, 2 phases of power to the property).  He then quickly sent a proposal through for a 12kw 2 phase system.  A month later the sytems is running, just waiting for the power company to do their bit now.  There were a few teething problems which Justin has promptly sorted out.If you live in the Border area Justin is the man.

Justin was fantastic, he got in touch quickly, made us very comfortable with our investment and has followed up with all the right regulations to ensure we are compliant!Justin and his helper installed our system within 3 weeks of us signing off on the quote, was significant;y better priced than a previous quote we had received and really knew what he was talking about. He has even offered to come back free of charge if we have any issues and will also help us out with general electrican work around teh place so we're really happy.

The whole process from start to finish was professional and timely. They listened to my objectives, quoted and supplied a system to my exact needs. No question was left unanswered.  I couldn't be happier.

Came to us with excellent recommendation.From the initial phone discussion through face-to-face info session and finally installation, the process could not have been cleaner or more professional.It has been a pleasure to deal with Justin and we wish him well in his future growth.

I started the process with almost zero knowledge about Solar. I came across Peak Solar & Electrical by chance and so glad I did. Justin came to my home to provide a quote and arrived exactly when he said he would. He was able to walk me through all of the information from the absolute basics and answer any questions I had and explain it in an easy to understand way. He was patient and listened to all of my concerns regarding some of the negative things you hear about solar installation and put my mind at ease. It was immediately clear that Justin is super passionate and knowledgeable about what he does and the products he supplies and making sure even the smallest things are looked after and done properly. He had great communication throughout the whole process and was always happy to answer any questions I had very thoroughly with absolutely no pressure.Once I had accepted the quote the process was so simple and easy and within a few short weeks my solar was up and running and doing everything I had hoped and been promised with zero stress or worry for me. The installation was neat and tidy with no trace that he had been there other than the solar panels being on my roof. If I did it all over again the only thing I would have done is do it sooner!

Fantastic experience with Justin. Exceptional communication and explained every step of the way. Quick to return quote, install and kept everything moving at a great pace. Looked after everything from quote through to install to getting the meter updated. Cannot recommend Peak Solar enough.

Justin was outstanding from the start. First to respond, instant communication throughout, nothing was ever too much trouble and his pride in his workmanship (the selling point for me) was second to none.I even had the electrical inspector applaud his workmanship and quality of parts used.I have since booked Justin for another system in the near future.

My experience with peak solar was absolute gorgeous, Justin helped me capture as many of the lords glorious rays as I possibly could off my humble house, I have told all of my friends down at Sunday service and he can be expecting some calls I tell you that right now. Absolutely blessed experience thank you Justin.

Justin and his team did a great solar fit on our property. He was a pleasure to deal with and the process was smooth and easy. He was very easy to communicate with and I would highly recommend him to anyone considering installing solar you will not be disappointed. Good luck Justin I am sure you will go far in your business.

Our new solar system is awesome, not only does it perform flawlessly and reduce electricity bills substantially but also looks very smart with dark coloured mounts and rails on our monument roof.Justin was prompt and punctual, alongside being very well priced.

Excellent quote, polite, respectful installer. Justin doesn’t rest until the job is done! We didn’t have to lift a finger, he dealt with all the details.He obviously has a passion for what he does and for saving his customers money!

We are super happy with the whole process that Peak Solar Solutions gave us. From what we needed to save money on our electricity bill, the install was very prompt and customer service was outstanding going above and beyond to make us happy. We no longer have an electricity bill we are in credit that is a huge saving for us. Highly Recommend this company you won’t be disappointed.

Justin was fantastic through the whole process from the first enquire to following up to ensure the feed in tariff began with the electricity company. I would highly recommend Peak Solar Solutions for anyone wanting Solar.

Quoting was well done explaining how the system works and any options we wanted to addInstallation was professionally done neat and a excellent quality job punctual always on time and kept in contact via mobile or messaging and emailCustomer service was excellent very well explaining everything. Help installing the app on my phone arranged grid connectionI would highly recommend Peak Solar Solutions to other peopleExcellent job friendly and a high quality of workmanship
